query:
SELECT id, discipline, title, year, seoKeywords,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projectTags WHERE projectTags.projectId = projects.id) as tag_count
FROM projects 
WHERE discipline IN ('experiential_design', 'rendering', 'scenic_models')
ORDER BY 
  CASE discipline
    WHEN 'experiential_design' THEN 1
    WHEN 'rendering' THEN 2
    WHEN 'scenic_models' THEN 3
  END,
  year DESC, title ASC;
